alt: 野餐桌旁，兩個孩子互使眼色，一人把水果籃藏到椅下，另一人指向遠處引開同學注意，桌上的公用果盤已空了一角。
scene_prompt: At a school picnic table two mischievous older children exchange a conspiratorial grin and secret thumbs-up behind their backs. One hides a basket of the shared picnic fruit under the bench while the other distracts an innocent classmate by pointing away; a few missing fruits leave a conspicuous empty patch in the communal bowl on the table. The two act together unfairly for their own benefit, clearly distinguished from friendly honest cooperation. Keep it mild, no teaching of theft techniques, locks or money, no violence. Three children, natural hands, no speech bubbles or writing.
